about_the_game:
All Aboard: The Amtrak Viewliner Experience

Step aboard and rediscover the magic of long-distance train travel in America’s East. The Amtrak Viewliner DLC brings you an immersive, authentic journey through time – blending modern railroading with timeless comfort and style.

Experience the full range of Amtrak’s iconic Viewliner fleet, from the classic Viewliner I cars to the sleek, upgraded Viewliner II series. Feel the power of the legendary P42DC locomotive in Phase V, leading your train across scenic landscapes, vibrant cities, and quiet countryside.

Whether you're relaxing in the cozy sleeper cabin, dining in the Viewliner café, or hauling luggage in the baggage car, every detail has been lovingly recreated to make you feel like you're truly onboard. Realistic interiors, dynamic lighting, authentic sounds, and interactive features bring your journey to life like never before.

Included in this DLC:

Locomotive:

  • Amtrak P42DC Phase V – iconic power, fully featured cab.

Rolling Stock:

  • Viewliner I Sleeper

  • Viewliner II Sleeper

  • Viewliner I Diner

  • Viewliner II Diner

  • Viewliner Baggage

  • Viewliner Baggage Dorm

Key Features:

  • passenger interiors with responsive day/night lighting

  • Functional couplers, brake hoses, and automatic door steps

  • Dynamic weathering and dirt accumulation

  • Realistic physics including fuel consumption

  • Deadman’s switch and authentic cab elements

  • Interior views for sleepers, diners, and café areas

  • Compatible Amfleet door-step animations

Why This DLC?

Because this isn’t just a train – it’s a journey.
A story. A moment of peace between departure and arrival.

Imagine leaving New York at sunset. City lights flicker past as the train glides into the night. You sit by the window, lulled by the rhythm of the rails, knowing you’re on a true American adventure.

This is railroading with soul – and now, it’s yours to command.

Book Your Journey Now!

Whether you’re a longtime railfan, a lover of immersive simulations, or simply someone who appreciates the charm of the open rails, the Amtrak Viewliner DLC is your ticket to unforgettable experiences.

Climb aboard. Your next great journey begins today.
